entities.name: Query enzyme
observations: 346 aa cytosolic enzyme sequence; calculated molecular mass 36.94 kDa and pI 4.93.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q7N3F7, annotated as phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase.
Contains AIRS domain PF00586 at residues 60–164 and AIRS_C domain PF02769 at residues 176–334.

entities.name: Phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase
observations: EC 6.3.3.1; reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs support assignment with 100% identity and 100% query/target coverage.
Catalyzes the second and final step converting formylglycinamidine ribonucleotide to 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole in de novo IMP biosynthesis.
Annotated to phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase activity and phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase activity.

entities.name: RHEA:23032
observations: This ATP-dependent cyclo-ligation/ring-closure reaction forms the imidazole ring of the purine precursor AIR.

entities.name: De novo purine biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the final step of the FGAM-to-AIR segment in IMP biosynthesis and contributes to adenine biosynthesis.
